_comment: Reachable advisories explicitly accepted by the vulnerability gate (scripts/vulncheck.sh).
An entry belongs here only when the advisory is reachable AND has no available fix.
Every entry expires on its review_by date, after which the gate fails until the entry
is re-justified or removed. Advisories not listed here still fail the gate. See REVIEW.md.

allow.reason: golang.org/x/crypto/openpgp is unmaintained by design and has no fixed version. It is reached only through the Cosmos SDK keyring's armored key encoding, never from twilight-core code, and cannot be removed while on cosmos-sdk v0.53.x.
allow.tracking: Expected to clear via the deferred cosmos-sdk upgrade; re-check at review time whether a newer SDK drops the openpgp dependency.

allow.reachable_via: twilightd -> cosmos-sdk/server -> cometbft/node, whose blank import `_ "github.com/lib/pq"` registers the driver with database/sql (cometbft/node/setup.go)
allow.reason: GSS authentication completes without mutual proof. Requires performing GSSAPI auth against a Postgres server. The driver is registered, never opened: lib/pq code runs only once a Postgres connection is made, which requires tx_index.indexer = "psql". This chain does not configure a psql sink anywhere, so no connection is ever established. No fixed version exists: every published lib/pq release is affected, and v1.12.3 (latest) reports MORE advisories than v1.10.9, not fewer.
allow.tracking: Re-check at review time whether CometBFT still links lib/pq, and whether the upstream advisories have gained a fixed version. Expected to clear via the deferred cosmos-sdk / CometBFT upgrade if that drops the psql sink.
